title: Collateral gaps during the margin period of risk
prompt: Losses are positive for losses and negative for gains. VaR at alpha is inf{x: P(loss<=x)>=alpha}; ES is the mean of the worst 1-alpha probability mass, taking only the necessary fraction of any boundary atom. Condition on counterparty default now. Replacement mark is20 and posted bond collateral currently has market value20, recognized at18 under a10% margin haircut. No further margin is received. At closeout, the mark changes and collateral market prices fall by the scenario amounts supplied. Realize collateral at its then market value less2% liquidation cost; do NOT apply the original recognition haircut again. Any positive unsecured remainder loses60%; negative remainder produces zero credit loss. Report unsecured exposures by state, expected default loss, and95% ES of default loss, all conditional on this default.
